items.title_verbatim: Cattle grazing in the open near a small stream on the Santa Margarita cattle ranch in San Diego County, 1900
items.description_verbatim: Photograph of a small herd of cattle (less than 50 head) grazing in the open near a small stream on the Santa Margarita cattle ranch in San Diego County, 1900. A copse of oak trees is visible behind the cattle, which stand at center. The narrow, shallow stream is pictured to the right of center running from the distance under the dipping trees to the left foreground.
